messages:
Priya: Heads up — Oakmont asked for customer-managed encryption (CMEK) for audit exports + a 10-year immutability window. They're evaluating Dedicated + Private deployments.
Devon: Do we have legal precedent for 10y? @Sam can you weigh in?
Sam: Finance customers often ask 7–10y. Immutability plus CMEK raises eDiscovery and export/escrow issues. We should offer a temporary manual legal-hold while we build automation.
Anna: From security: CMEK on export is straightforward, immutability is heavy operationally. Object-lock semantics (S3-compatible) + key-retention policy complicate key rotation/escape hatches.
Marco: For prioritization I'd split work: MVP = CMEK for audit exports + tenant-level retention config (up to 3y). Phase 2 = immutable export buckets + legal-hold automation + 7–10y options.
Priya: Good. Let's list MVP launch criteria so Sales has something concrete.
Devon: MVP acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Export API accepts `export.cmek_key` (string) and persists metadata. 2) Admin UI to configure CMEK per-tenant. 3) Support for one KMS provider (AWS KMS first). 4) Docs + compliance signoff. 5) E2E tests for key binding and export integrity.
Anna: Ops constraints to add: immutable exports require object-lock support on storage. If the customer's storage doesn't support it, fallback = manual legal-hold via Ops ticket.
Marco: Rough effort: Eng-platform 3 sprints to wire CMEK through pipeline, infra 1 sprint to provision KMS integration, devex 1 sprint for UI + docs. Phase 2 is larger (object-lock, legal-hold automation).
Priya: Risk note: any customer contract promising 10y immutability should be triaged to Legal and Escrow team — we shouldn't promise automated immutability in MVP.
Sam: Agreed. Sales playbook: offer 'legal-hold via service request' for now and price enterprise escrow separately.
ops-bot: deploy:analysis: Export pipeline changes: add `retention_days`, `immute=true/false`, `held_by` metadata, and CMEK key fingerprint. Backfill process needs to mark existing exports without immutability.
Devon: Next steps: Marco to draft a short PRD with scope/launch criteria, Anna to add security constraints, Sam to add legal notes, Priya to sync with Sales.
Marco: I'll draft the PRD and include rollout gates + migration notes. Target: PRD ready by EOD Friday.
Priya: Thanks — I'll block time with Sales + Solutions to halt any promises for automated 7–10y immutability. Sync meeting Tue 10am to finalize scope. :thumbsup:
